task_title: Name accepted cadences in the 400 and document the dedup 409
task_criteria: AC1: POST /api/v1/problems/submit with an unknown cadence returns HTTP 400 and the message names all three accepted values (pre-phase, end-of-day, post-debug), asserted by a unit test in internal/ingest. AC2: README.md submit section and docs/api-reference.md document the deduplicated outcome (HTTP 409, status=deduplicated, existing submission_id + position). AC3: internal/solver/failure_hint.go exposes FailureHint which appends an actionable hint naming openrouter.ai/settings/privacy for the OpenRouter guardrail-restriction failure text, tested by TestFailureHint in internal/solver/failure_hint_test.go and called from internal/cron/loop.go. go build ./... and go test ./... -short pass.
